=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: lines 3183-3190 (third sentence: "If the issue names files only in its scope or acceptance criteria, stay inside those files.") | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The third sentence of the Restrictions rule lacks the fragment exception that the first sentence ("stay inside that set plus this issue's own changelog.d/ and agents.d/ fragments") and the second sentence ("plus only this issue's own agents.d/ fragment") both carry. An editor that reads sentence 3 in isolation may skip the issue's own `changelog.d/<N>-*.md` (and, on a non-heal issue, `agents.d/<N>-*.md` fragment, even though `prompts/mode-implement.txt:88-99` and `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:1189-1194` (`heal_own_agents_fragment_entry`) confirm the guard always allows the issue's own fragments.
  WHY: an editor that strictly interprets sentence 3 produces no changelog fragment, which fails `tests/test_changelog_fragment_contract.py` for any observable-behavior change whose issue body names files only in scope/acceptance. Most LLMs will generalize correctly from sentences 1-2, so this is a clarity/consistency gap rather than a deterministic failure.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  WHY: An implement run whose scope or acceptance criteria names source files but not a changelog fragment is instructed not to create that fragment, even when the change requires one under the changelog discipline. The resulting change set can omit the required changelog entry.
